description: Midazolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine that enhances the effects of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) at the GABA-A receptor, producing sedative, anxiolytic, muscle relaxant, and anticonvulsant effects. It is widely used for procedural sedation, induction of anesthesia, acute seizure management, and severe agitation. Available in oral, injectable, and intranasal forms.

sections.content: Midazolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine that enhances the effects of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) at the GABA-A receptor, producing sedative, anxiolytic, muscle relaxant, and anticonvulsant effects. It is widely used for procedural sedation, induction of anesthesia, acute seizure management, and severe agitation. Available in oral, injectable, and intranasal forms.
